refined_prompt: A northern Vietnamese young woman in a four-panel dress with a sash. A young woman in northern Vietnam is wearing an áo tứ thân, a traditional four-panel dress often worn during cultural events and ceremonies. Crafted from soft silk, the áo tứ thân features intricate embroidery with vibrant floral patterns along the cuffs and hem, creating a flowing silhouette when the panels are sewn together. This dress is an essential part of Vietnamese culture, symbolizing grace and elegance, and it is frequently seen at traditional celebrations such as weddings and Tet (Lunar New Year). The áo tứ thân is distinct from other traditional Vietnamese dresses due to its unique four-panel design. It is often paired with traditional búp bê shoes, small embroidered slippers that complement the dress perfectly.
